description: Record an opt-in or opt-out from your own system (CRM, checkout, a form). An opt-in for a marketing registration needs proof (source, when, the page).

campaign_id.description: Only with opted_in: the registration the person opted in to. A marketing send from a number linked to that registration looks for this record. Proof is required when its use case is marketing or mixed (400 otherwise). An opt-out is always account-wide.

note.description: A note kept on the consent record

proof.description: Opt-in evidence (Messaging Policy 1.4). Accepted only with status opted_in.

campaign_id.description: The registration the opt-in is for (reg_...)

collected_at.description: When the person consented; defaults to now

ip.description: The person's IP address when they opted in

message_id.description: The inbound message that was the opt-in. Required for keyword opt-ins recorded for a marketing registration

registration_id.description: The registration the opt-in is for (reg_...)

user_agent.description: The person's browser user agent when they opted in

name: set_consent
title: Set consent
